def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            nbs={}
            for di,dj in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
                if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W: nbs[(di,dj)]=g[ni][nj]
            if g[i][j] in nbs.values(): continue  # not isolated
            c=Counter(nbs.values()); m=max(c.values())
            tied=[col for col,v in c.items() if v==m]
            if len(tied)==1: out[i][j]=tied[0]; continue
            # tie-break: solid 2x2 completion
            pick=None
            for col in tied:
                for di in(-1,1):
                    for dj in(-1,1):
                        cells=[(i+di,j),(i,j+dj),(i+di,j+dj)]
                        if all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==col for a,b in cells): pick=col
            out[i][j]=pick if pick is not None else tied[0]
    return out
# check noise detection: any isolated cell NOT changed?

               and (i,j) not in {(i,j) for i,j,_,_ in diffs}]

def denoise(grid):
    """Every isolated cell (no orthogonal neighbor of its color) recolored to the majority color of its orthogonal neighbors, ties broken toward the rarer color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            nbs=[grid[i+di][j+dj] for di,dj in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)) if 0<=i+di<H and 0<=j+dj<W]
            if not nbs or grid[i][j] in nbs: continue
            c=Counter(nbs); m=max(c.values())
            tied=[col for col,v in c.items() if v==m]
            out[i][j]=min(tied,key=lambda col:cnt[col]) if len(tied)>1 else tied[0]
    return out
''')
lib.close()
